# Blocks

A unit is built from these blocks. Name the ones a task needs; each has a card with its calls. `unit` is always needed.

- `unit` — the class you write, and the context every block hangs off
- `settings` — values the user configures
- `market` — live quotes, trades, bars and depth for any instruments
- `history` — stored bars and trades from the past, for warm-up and backfill
- `instruments` — find instruments and read tick size, multiplier, currency
- `clock` — the current market time
- `schedule` — timers, and running work on the unit's thread
- `orders` — change positions — using this block makes the unit a strategy
- `portfolio` — read positions, fills and P&L
- `alerts` — notify the user
- `log` — write to the activity log
- `state` — remember values across restarts
- `export` — let the user save text or CSV
- `ui` — send data to the unit's own web page and receive its messages
- `math.averages` — smoothers, rolling windows and running statistics
- `math.indicators` — RSI, ATR, MACD, Bollinger bands, VWAP, realised volatility
- `math.regression` — regression, correlation, mean reversion and Kalman filters
- `math.orderflow` — trade classification, flow imbalance, VPIN, book and footprint maths
- `math.performance` — equity-curve and trade statistics
- `math.learning` — online learners and forecast scoring
- `math.geometry` — 3D vectors, camera and projection
- `network` — call external APIs and streams directly (HTTP, WebSocket)
